failure_modes: Brute-forced schedules that break badly when they fail
Optimizing for the plan instead of the person
gloss: A long-lived agent that helps a person choose goals and keep their baseline, without rigid command
invariants: Person, not the agent, owns the goals
mechanism: The companion holds the person's accumulated preferences in a {{innate}} layer across sessions. It helps examine goals against {{misspec}}, keeps the {{pillars}} in order, and prompts a {{felt}} check before actions. Its style follows {{flow}}: a period of structure builds habits, then flexibility returns so the person is not living under a corset.
